title: Add `done` and `list --pending` to the todo CLI
spec: Extend todo.py: `python3 todo.py done ID` marks item ID done (exit 1 with a message on stderr if no such item); `python3 todo.py list --pending` lists only items not yet done, in the same format as `list`. Keep existing behaviour. Add unit tests (use the TODO_DB environment variable to point at a temporary file) runnable with `python3 -m unittest -q`.
acceptance: `done ID` marks the item done and `list` shows [x] for it
